requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can add a new hire and their standard onboarding checklist is automatically generated across IT, HR and Facilities

criteria.must: An HR Coordinator can submit a new hire's name, email and start date
After adding a new hire, checklist tasks exist for IT, HR and Facilities
The generated checklist matches the current standard template's tasks

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member sees only the IT onboarding tasks assigned for each new hire

criteria.must: IT Staff's task view lists only tasks belonging to the IT department
IT Staff's task view does not show HR or Facilities tasks

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member sees only the Facilities onboarding tasks assigned for each new hire

criteria.must: Facilities Staff's task view lists only tasks belonging to the Facilities department
Facilities Staff's task view does not show IT or HR tasks

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator sees and completes the HR-specific onboarding tasks for each new hire

criteria.must: The HR Coordinator's view lists HR-department tasks for a new hire
The HR Coordinator can mark an HR task complete

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member can mark their assigned tasks complete

criteria.must: IT Staff can mark an IT task complete
A completed IT task's status updates to completed and is visible to the HR Coordinator

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member can mark their assigned tasks complete

criteria.must: Facilities Staff can mark a Facilities task complete
A completed Facilities task's status updates to completed and is visible to the HR Coordinator

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can view overall onboarding progress for each new hire across all three departments

criteria.must: The HR Coordinator can open a view showing a new hire's task status across IT, HR and Facilities together

requirements.statement: An IT Staff member is reminded when a task assigned to them becomes overdue

criteria.must: A task whose due date passes uncompleted is marked overdue
IT Staff receives an in-app reminder notification for their overdue task

requirements.statement: A Facilities Staff member is reminded when a task assigned to them becomes overdue

criteria.must: Facilities Staff receives an in-app reminder notification for their overdue task

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator is reminded when their own HR tasks become overdue, and escalated to when any IT or Facilities task for a new hire runs overdue

criteria.must: The HR Coordinator receives an in-app reminder notification for their own overdue HR task
The HR Coordinator receives an in-app escalation notification when an IT task runs overdue
The HR Coordinator receives an in-app escalation notification when a Facilities task runs overdue

requirements.statement: A New Hire can view their own onboarding checklist and see which items are done, in progress, or overdue

criteria.must: A New Hire can view a checklist listing their own onboarding tasks
Each task on the New Hire's checklist shows its status (done, pending, or overdue)
A New Hire cannot mark any task complete

requirements.statement: An HR Coordinator can define and edit the standard checklist's tasks, including department ownership and due-date offset

criteria.must: The HR Coordinator can add a new template task specifying title, department and due-date offset
The HR Coordinator can edit an existing template task's department or due-date offset
A change to the template does not retroactively alter already-generated checklists for existing new hires
